final: WITH per_team AS (SELECT team_id, SUM(games) AS games FROM home_game GROUP BY team_id), total AS (SELECT SUM(games) AS total_games FROM per_team), shares AS (SELECT per_team.team_id, per_team.games, per_team.games * 1.0 / total.total_games AS share FROM per_team CROSS JOIN total), mean_share AS (SELECT AVG(games) AS mean_games FROM shares) SELECT shares.team_id, shares.games, shares.share, shares.games * 1.0 / mean_share.mean_games AS relative_to_mean FROM shares CROSS JOIN mean_share ORDER BY relative_to_mean DESC LIMIT 10
